# Version 4.152.0 (Unreleased)
> **Graphite GPU and new platforms**

> **API changes** · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 brings the Graphite GPU backend, Nano Server font support, and Skia m152. This release adds next-generation Graphite GPU bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, and FreeType-backed text on Windows Nano Server. Several memory and allocation fixes land alongside the Skia m152 engine upgrade.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia milestone m152 engine** — The bundled Skia engine advances to m152, including upstream chrome/m151 bug-fix syncs carried over from the 4.151.x line. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568))
- **Deterministic binding generation** — Binding generation now produces identical output regardless of the build platform, eliminating spurious diffs when regenerating on different OSes. ([#4612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4612))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn** — New bindings expose Skia's next-generation Graphite rendering pipeline. Consumers can create Graphite GPU contexts for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn backends, unlocking a modern, lower-overhead GPU path. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Backend-neutral async RequestReadPixels on SKImage and SKSurface** — A new async pixel-readback API lets callers read pixel data from GPU-backed images and surfaces without blocking the render thread, working across all supported GPU backends. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **New SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package** — A dedicated NuGet package wraps the Silk.NET Vulkan interop layer, making it straightforward to wire up Vulkan contexts without custom P/Invoke boilerplate. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native use-after-free in SKRegion.SpanIterator fixed** — The SKRegion backing the SpanIterator was not rooted and could be collected mid-iteration, causing a native use-after-free crash. The region is now correctly kept alive for the iterator's lifetime. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355))
- **Native use-after-free in SKPixmap.ExtractSubset fixed** — The pixel source passed to ExtractSubset and With* methods was not rooted and could be garbage-collected before the native call completed. ([#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **Memory leak in SKImage.Create raster failure path fixed** — A CoTaskMem pixel buffer allocated during raster image creation was not freed on native call failure, leading to a silent native memory leak. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))
- **Reduced allocations across text and uniform-lookup paths** — GetEncodedText no longer allocates an intermediate string on the null-terminated fast path, and SKRuntimeEffectUniforms pre-sizes its lookup map to the known uniform count. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **HandleDictionary skip-registration check cached** — The per-type reflection check that determines whether to skip registration in the handle dictionary is now cached, removing repeated reflection overhead on hot object-construction paths. ([#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630))
- **SKData.SaveTo allocation eliminated** — SKData.SaveTo no longer copies the buffer twice; it now streams directly, halving memory use for large data saves. ([#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550))

## Platform

- **FreeType font rendering on Windows Nano Server** — Nano Server environments lack the GDI font stack. SkiaSharp now uses FreeType on Nano Server, enabling text rendering in containerised Windows workloads that was previously broken. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server test targets** — Containerised CI test legs for Azure Linux, Alpine (musl libc), and Nano Server continuously validate SkiaSharp across these production-relevant environments. ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515))
- **Windows MSVC environment initialized once per native build** — The MSVC environment setup is now shared across build steps instead of re-run for each target, reducing Windows native build times. — ❤️ [@mmitche](https://github.com/mmitche) ([#4570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4570))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 ships unchanged from 4.151.0, with no new API changes in this release.
